name: pdf-form-fill
description: List the fields of a fillable PDF and fill them in one step.

interface.longDescription:
List and fill the fields of a PDF form document from your answers in the chat. Zovo PDF Form Fill lists the fields of the form you attach (text boxes, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns and list boxes) with the printed label next to each field, its options, its length limit and whether it is required. The assistant can then match your answers to the right fields, even when the field names are codes such as f1_01.

When you give the answers, the tool checks them before anything is written. Unknown field names are refused with the 3 closest names. Options that the form does not list are refused with the list of valid options. Text that is longer than a field allows is refused. A case-only difference in an option ("evening" for "Evening") is accepted and reported.

The filled PDF is then opened again and each value is read back and compared with your request, so the reply says how many values were confirmed. It also lists the required fields that are still empty and the signature fields that are left for you to sign. You can keep the fields editable or flatten them into the page.

In the widget you can edit the values in a table, press Fill, and download the result.

Limitations: standard fillable PDFs (AcroForm) only, up to 20 MB and 2,000 fields. XFA-only forms and password-protected PDFs are refused with a reason. Signature fields are not signed. Field text can use Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and Vietnamese letters; CJK, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji are not supported. The filled PDF is kept for about 1 hour, then deleted.
defaultPrompt: List the fields in this PDF form and tell me which ones are required
Fill this form: name Jane Doe, email jane@example.com, shift Evening, and check the agree box
Fill the attached form with my details and flatten it so the answers are locked into the page

positive.description: List the fields of a fillable form
positive.prompt: List the fields in the attached volunteer sign-up form PDF (all-types.pdf) with their labels and options
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_form_fields on the attached PDF and reports 10 fields: 5 text, 1 checkbox, 1 radio, 1 dropdown, 1 listbox and 1 signature. The field full_name has the label Full name, the ZIP code field has a maximum length of 5, the Shift radio group has the options Morning, Afternoon and Evening, and 3 required fields are empty.

positive.description: Fill a form with all field types
positive.prompt: Fill the attached volunteer form: Jane Doe, jane@example.com, ZIP 02139, phone +1 415 555 0100, agree yes, shift Evening, T-shirt L, interests Garden and Driving
positive.expected_behavior: Calls fill_pdf_form with 8 values. The reply says 8 fields were filled and the read-back check confirms 8 of 8 values, including ZIP 02139 and phone +1 415 555 0100. No required field is empty, the signature field is left for signing, and a download link for the filled PDF is given.

positive.description: Map coded field names to printed labels
positive.prompt: Which field in the attached w9-like.pdf is the name line, and which checkbox is C corporation?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_form_fields and reports 11 fields. The field topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_01[0] has the label 1 Name (as shown on your income tax return) and is required; the checkbox c1_1[1] has the label C corporation. The date field f1_10[0] has a maximum length of 10.

positive.prompt: Fill w9-like.pdf: name Jane Doe, Individual/sole proprietor box, address 12 Main Street, Apt 4, city Springfield, IL 62701, date 11/04/2026. Flatten it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_form_fields to learn the names, then fill_pdf_form with 5 values and flatten true. The reply says 5 fields were filled, the read-back check confirms 5 of 5 values including 62701 and 11/04/2026, the values were flattened into the page, and a download link is given.

positive.description: Accented names and a case-only option match
positive.prompt: Fill the attached volunteer form with name Łukasz Żółć, email lukasz@example.com, shift evening, and notes on two lines: Line one / Line two
positive.expected_behavior: Calls fill_pdf_form. The reply says 4 fields were filled and 4 of 4 values were read back, that the option evening was matched to Evening, that the name uses an embedded font for the Polish letters, and that the required fields phone and agree are still empty.

negative.description: Signing a contract is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called to sign; the assistant explains that signature fields are not signed by this tool.
negative.prompt: Sign this contract PDF with my signature and send it back to the landlord

negative.description: Writing a cover letter is not a form job. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant writes the letter in chat.
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a marketing manager job

negative.description: Converting a PDF table to a spreadsheet is a different job. Expected: the tool is not called.
negative.prompt: Convert the tables in this bank statement PDF to Excel

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list fillable PDF form fields with their printed labels, fill text, checkbox, radio, dropdown and list box fields with checks, read the filled PDF back to confirm each value, optional flattening.

pl-PL.subtitle: Wypełnianie formularzy PDF
pl-PL.description:
Wypełnij formularz PDF odpowiedziami z czatu. Zovo PDF Form Fill wyświetla pola dołączonego formularza (pola tekstowe, pola wyboru, przyciski opcji, listy rozwijane i listy) z etykietą wydrukowaną obok każdego pola, jego opcjami, limitem długości i informacją, czy jest wymagane.

Przed zapisem odpowiedzi są sprawdzane. Nieznane nazwy pól są odrzucane z 3 najbliższymi nazwami, opcje spoza listy są odrzucane z listą poprawnych opcji, a zbyt długi tekst jest odrzucany. Wypełniony PDF jest ponownie otwierany, a każda wartość jest odczytywana i porównywana z prośbą. Pola można zostawić edytowalne lub spłaszczyć.

Ograniczenia: tylko standardowe formularze PDF (AcroForm), do 20 MB i 2000 pól. Formularze tylko XFA i pliki chronione hasłem są odrzucane. Pola podpisu nie są podpisywane. Wypełniony PDF jest przechowywany przez około 1 godzinę, a potem usuwany.

de-DE.subtitle: PDF-Formulare ausfüllen
de-DE.description:
Füllen Sie ein ausfüllbares PDF-Formular mit Ihren Antworten aus dem Chat aus. Zovo PDF Form Fill listet die Felder des angehängten Formulars auf (Textfelder, Kontrollkästchen, Optionsfelder, Dropdowns und Listenfelder), jeweils mit der gedruckten Beschriftung daneben, den Optionen, der Längenbegrenzung und ob das Feld Pflicht ist.

Vor dem Schreiben werden die Antworten geprüft. Unbekannte Feldnamen werden mit den 3 ähnlichsten Namen abgelehnt, nicht vorhandene Optionen mit der Liste gültiger Optionen, zu langer Text ebenfalls. Das ausgefüllte PDF wird erneut geöffnet und jeder Wert wird zurückgelesen und mit der Anfrage verglichen. Die Felder bleiben bearbeitbar oder werden auf Wunsch reduziert (flatten).

Einschränkungen: nur Standard-PDF-Formulare (AcroForm), bis 20 MB und 2.000 Felder. Reine XFA-Formulare und passwortgeschützte PDFs werden abgelehnt. Signaturfelder werden nicht signiert. Das ausgefüllte PDF wird etwa 1 Stunde gespeichert und dann gelöscht.

es-ES.subtitle: Rellena formularios PDF
es-ES.description:
Rellena un formulario PDF con las respuestas del chat. Zovo PDF Form Fill muestra los campos del formulario adjunto (cuadros de texto, casillas, botones de opción, desplegables y listas) con la etiqueta impresa junto a cada campo, sus opciones, su límite de longitud y si es obligatorio.

Las respuestas se comprueban antes de escribir nada. Los nombres de campo desconocidos se rechazan con los 3 nombres más parecidos, las opciones que no existen se rechazan con la lista de opciones válidas y el texto demasiado largo también se rechaza. El PDF rellenado se vuelve a abrir y cada valor se lee y se compara con la petición. Puedes dejar los campos editables o aplanarlos.

Limitaciones: solo formularios PDF estándar (AcroForm), hasta 20 MB y 2000 campos. Los formularios solo XFA y los PDF con contraseña se rechazan. Los campos de firma no se firman. El PDF rellenado se guarda durante 1 hora aproximadamente y después se elimina.

fr-FR.subtitle: Remplir des formulaires PDF
fr-FR.description:
Remplissez un formulaire PDF avec les réponses données dans la conversation. Zovo PDF Form Fill liste les champs du formulaire joint (zones de texte, cases à cocher, boutons radio, listes déroulantes et listes) avec le libellé imprimé à côté de chaque champ, ses options, sa longueur maximale et s'il est obligatoire.

Les réponses sont vérifiées avant toute écriture. Un nom de champ inconnu est refusé avec les 3 noms les plus proches, une option absente est refusée avec la liste des options valides, et un texte trop long est refusé. Le PDF rempli est rouvert et chaque valeur est relue et comparée à la demande. Les champs restent modifiables ou peuvent être aplatis.

Limites : formulaires PDF standard (AcroForm) uniquement, jusqu'à 20 Mo et 2 000 champs. Les formulaires XFA seuls et les PDF protégés par mot de passe sont refusés. Les champs de signature ne sont pas signés. Le PDF rempli est conservé environ 1 heure, puis supprimé.

ja-JP.subtitle: PDFフォームに入力
ja-JP.description:
チャットで伝えた回答で、入力可能なPDFフォームを埋めます。Zovo PDF Form Fill は、添付したフォームのフィールド（テキスト、チェックボックス、ラジオボタン、ドロップダウン、リスト）を、横に印刷されたラベル、選択肢、文字数の上限、必須かどうかと一緒に一覧にします。

書き込む前に回答をチェックします。存在しないフィールド名は近い名前3つを添えて拒否し、フォームにない選択肢は有効な選択肢の一覧を添えて拒否し、長すぎるテキストも拒否します。入力済みのPDFを開き直し、各値を読み戻して依頼内容と照合します。フィールドは編集可能なまま残すことも、フラット化することもできます。

制限事項：標準のPDFフォーム（AcroForm）のみ、20 MB・2,000フィールドまで。XFAのみのフォームとパスワード付きPDFは理由を示して拒否します。署名フィールドには署名しません。入力済みPDFは約1時間保存された後に削除されます。

pt-BR.subtitle: Preencha formulários PDF
pt-BR.description:
Preencha um formulário PDF com as respostas dadas no chat. O Zovo PDF Form Fill lista os campos do formulário anexado (caixas de texto, caixas de seleção, botões de opção, menus suspensos e listas) com o rótulo impresso ao lado de cada campo, suas opções, o limite de tamanho e se é obrigatório.

As respostas são verificadas antes de qualquer gravação. Nomes de campo desconhecidos são recusados com os 3 nomes mais próximos, opções que não existem são recusadas com a lista de opções válidas e textos longos demais também são recusados. O PDF preenchido é aberto de novo e cada valor é lido e comparado com o pedido. Os campos podem continuar editáveis ou ser achatados.

Limitações: apenas formulários PDF padrão (AcroForm), até 20 MB e 2.000 campos. Formulários só XFA e PDFs com senha são recusados. Campos de assinatura não são assinados. O PDF preenchido fica guardado por cerca de 1 hora e depois é excluído.
